railswheelsandtrains.configuration.title: Rails, Wheels & Trains settings
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.drive: Speed, reverser, throttle and brakes on the HUD while you are at the controls. Also switched in the driver's panel (L).
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.swayS: How hard car bodies rock and jolt on the track: 1 = as designed, 0 = never. A pack may make a car type rock more or less on top of this.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.camer: How much of the car's rocking tilts your view while riding: 1 = all of it (the camera is part of the car), 0 = the view stays level.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.train: Engines, wheels, rail joints, horns, doors and controls, on top of the 'Friendly Creatures' volume slider.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.inter: How near a car you must be, in blocks, to see its interior (seats, partitions, cab fittings) through the windows. 0 = always drawn (costs frame rate with many cars in view).
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.profi:
How the trains play.
REALISTIC: real figures; brake early, set handbrakes by hand (crowbar), couple gently.
STANDARD: real physics with stronger, quicker brakes and handbrakes that set themselves.
ARCADE: quick and forgiving; no wheel slip, a train slows by itself, couples at any speed.
CUSTOM: the values under "Custom profile".
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.custo: Used only when the profile is CUSTOM. Defaults are the STANDARD profile's.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.brake: Multiplies every brake force (train, locomotive and handbrakes).
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.resis: Multiplies running resistance; above 1 a train slows by itself once the throttle closes.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.respo: Multiplies how long brakes and engines take to follow the handles; 0 = at once.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.adhes: No wagon pulls or brakes harder than its wheels grip the rail.
Multiplies the wheel-rail adhesion (1 = dry rail).
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.auto_: Handbrakes set themselves when a train stands with the throttle shut and come off when the throttle opens; off = by hand only (crowbar).
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.hard_: A train never exceeds its slowest wagon's design speed; off = it can (downhill, pushed), only locomotive governors limit traction.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.coupl: Trains running together faster than this bump instead of coupling; 0 = couple at any speed.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.max_m: How far a rail marker looks for the marker it connects to: the longest segment one click of the rails builds. Longer segments cost more to build (the track bed is laid all along them, every chunk they cross is loaded).
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.clear: Building rails also clears the loading gauge over the new track: everything in it is broken without drops, so a hill gets a tunnel or a cutting a train fits, not just a slot for the track bed. Fluids stay. Refused like the bed: unbreakable blocks, blocks with contents, blocks the builder may not break.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.gauge: How far the cleared gauge reaches either side of the track centre (the widest MVP stock: 1.87).
How high the cleared gauge reaches over the rail head (MVP stock reaches up to about 5.3).
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.cab_a:
OPEN: anyone may open the doors into a cab, sit in a driver's chair and work the controls.
KEY: only a player carrying a driver's key (anywhere in the inventory); operators and creative players need none.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.chunk: Which trains keep the world loaded around them. Coupling never depends on it: a train meets standing wagons wherever they are.
MOVING: driven trains and any train on the move (rolled away, coasting).
DRIVEN: only trains with a player at the controls.
OFF: none; a train runs only where the world ticks anyway (near players).
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.linge: A train left standing with nobody at the controls lets its chunks go after this many seconds.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.unman: A train running with nobody at the controls keeps its chunks for at most this many seconds of the run, then stands frozen until someone comes near; 0 = for as long as it runs.
railswheelsandtrains.configuration.max_c: Most chunks one train keeps loaded (the way ahead and its leading end first).
